sources.title: GSK spinoff Haleon eyes billion-dollar Healthkart bet
Haleon In Talks To Acquire Controlling Stake In HealthKart At $1.4 Bn Valuation: Report

synopsis: UK-headquartered Haleon is in early talks to acquire a controlling stake in homegrown nutrition and supplements platform HealthKart in a deal that could value the company at $1.2-1.4 billion. The target is backed by Temasek and ChrysCapital, and is also exploring a dual-track process that includes an initial public offering on Indian bourses. Investment bank Avendus is likely advising HealthKart on the transaction, while a full sale is also being contemplated.
